feedback: The candidate is the iteration 9 build (kd 1.0, kp 3.5, sensors y 0.07 at x -0.04 to +0.04, sensor_size 0.012, line_loss last_direction) with one change: controller.base_speed 1.6 to 1.4. Geometry, kp, kd and line_loss are unchanged, so the race isolates speed. Iteration 9 is the best raced design at 387.98: the oval finished 20 of 20 (mean 1.875 s), while the s-bend (progress 0.35) and slalom (progress 0.18) still ended off track with steering_oscillation of about 0.19 to 0.20. Iteration 8 showed that lowering kp alone did not help the bends, so speed is the remaining untested lever for bend overshoot. Read from the candidate itself, the change is valid and inside every contract limit, and it is not obviously broken. The main risk is the oval: at 1.4 its mean time should scale to about 2.1 s, still inside the 3.0 s limit, but the margin narrows and completion-time credit drops slightly. I make no claim about how this candidate will perform. Approve now: it is a clean single-variable test, and one iteration remains after this one, so the race telemetry can drive a final adjustment. Interpret the race as follows. If the oval still finishes 20 of 20 and the s-bend or slalom progress rises above 0.35 and 0.18 with the score at or above 387.98, keep base_speed 1.4 and test kd 1.2 next. If the oval drops below 20 of 20 or the score falls below 387.98, the speed reduction is not paying off, so return base_speed to 1.6 with kd 1.0, the best raced design.
requested_changes: If the oval holds 20 of 20 and s-bend or slalom progress rises above 0.35 and 0.18 with the score at or above 387.98: keep base_speed 1.4 and try controller.kd 1.0 to 1.2 to test whether more damping clears the slalom, since iterations 3 to 9 showed kd increases were the only large gains.

If the oval finishes fall below 20 of 20 or the score falls below 387.98 (iteration 9 at base_speed 1.6): return controller.base_speed to 1.6 with kd 1.0 and kp 3.5, since that is the best raced design.

If the bends still fail with progress at or below 0.35 and 0.18 at base_speed 1.4 and steering_oscillation at or above 0.25: lower controller.base_speed further toward 1.2 only if the oval still finishes, since bend overshoot rather than gain has been the limit.
